entities.summary: Clara de Buen Richkarday is a Mexican architect. Along with his partners Aurelio Nuño and Carlos Mac Gregor they have received over time, without number of recognitions, among which are the Silver Medal of the Sixth Interarch 91 Architecture Biennial in Bulgaria, the Special Prize of the City of Frankfurt for the Metro stations on line A in Mexico City, as well as the "Antonio Attolini Lack" award for his career in 2009, by the Universidad Anáhuac campus México Sur.
